facts.statement: SOE ran a social networking promotion called ConnecDING, where players who followed the games on Twitter or Facebook could earn in-game prizes when SOE reached social networking goals.
facts.quote: Through what is being effectively called ConnecDING, SOE will be offering players a chance to earn some prizes

article_summaries.title: Earn In-Game Rewards for Social Networking with SOE
article_summaries.summary: Ten Ton Hammer reports that Sony Online Entertainment created Twitter and Facebook pages for Free Realms, EverQuest and EverQuest 2, and offered in-game rewards for social networking goals in a promotion called ConnecDING. The article is a promotional news item, not a Free Realms game-mechanics guide, and gives no quest, item or gameplay details for Free Realms itself.
